 Bestselling author, chef, entrepreneur and actor Ayesha Curry is taking on her biggest role yet, starring as the lead in the new rom-com “Second Chance Holiday.” She joins TODAY to talk about working on the holiday flick, executive producing “The Lost Boys” on Broadway and other genres she’d like to explore. “Life is short…just do the things!,” she says.
